The Sky Story

A landmark of its own on Naveen Chowk

Right beside Hari Kripa Guest House, near Green Field College, D Sky Café & Restaurant has become one of Sitapur's easiest-to-spot addresses — a three-storey glass front wrapped in electric-blue trim and strings of neon that turn heads on the Sitapur–Hardoi Road every night.

Inside, the mood softens: charcoal-grey lounge seating, indigo ceiling coves, potted greens on dark wood tables, and just enough ambient light to make a thali, a coffee, or a birthday order all feel a little special.

On the Table

Home-style thalis, plated for a night out

Comfort food served the way it's meant to be — hot tawa rotis, slow-cooked dal, a rich curry, and a crisp salad on the side. Easy on the pocket, generous on the plate.

  • D Sky Thali

    Tawa roti, dal tadka, paneer / vegetable curry, jeera aloo, fresh cucumber-onion-carrot salad.
